6.name: FILTER
6.hint: external capacitor CF to GND sets the bandwidth with the internal 1.7 kΩ (RF(INT)); the characteristics are given at CF = 1 nF

needs.source: Allegro ACS712-DS, Rev. 22 (February 13, 2024), MCO-0000197, p. 1 (Application 1: CF 1 nF, 'CF is recommended for noise management, with values that depend on the application') and p. 4 (terminal list)

7.name: VIOUT
7.hint: analog output, VCC/2 at 0 A (ratiometric); load at least 4.7 kΩ and at most 10 nF to GND

needs.source: Allegro ACS712-DS, Rev. 22 (February 13, 2024), MCO-0000197, p. 1, Application 1: CBYP 0.1 µF at VCC – the value shown, read as the minimum: assumption

hints: ACS712ELCTR-20A-T: optimized range ±20 A, sensitivity 100 mV/A (96 … 104 mV/A) at VCC 5 V, 25 °C (x20A PERFORMANCE CHARACTERISTICS, p. 6); output VCC/2 at 0 A, rising for current from IP+ to IP−; zero-current output and sensitivity are ratiometric to VCC (p. 1, p. 10) – an ADC that does not read from the same 5 V sees VCC's tolerance as error
the output swings around 2.5 V on 5 V: into a 3.3 V ADC it needs a divider or the ADC's range checked
the primary path IP+ → IP− (1.2 mΩ) is inside the part: edakit's simulation has no model for it and sees the two nets unconnected – the load current through the sensor is not simulated

isolation (p. 3): 2400 VRMS withstand for 60 s (UL 62368-1 ed. 3), basic-isolation working voltage 420 VPK/VDC or 297 VRMS, impulse 4000 VPK, clearance and creepage 4 mm, distance through insulation 63 µm – basic isolation only; the board's own clearance and creepage around the part are the layout's
overcurrent transient tolerance 100 A for one 100 ms pulse (absolute maximum, p. 2); operation above the optimized range is allowed as long as TJ stays at or below 165 °C (p. 5 note 1)
sources: Allegro ACS712-DS, Rev. 22 (February 13, 2024), MCO-0000197, https://www.allegromicro.com/-/media/files/datasheets/acs712-datasheet.pdf, downloaded and read 2026-10-31 (LCSC's copy for C10681 is the older Rev. 15 with 2.1 kVRMS isolation)
pinout and terminal list: p. 4 (pins 1–2 IP+, 3–4 IP−, 5 GND, 6 FILTER, 7 VIOUT, 8 VCC)

absolute maximum ratings, p. 2: VCC 8 V (reverse −0.1 V), VIOUT 8 V (reverse −0.1 V), output source 3 mA, sink 10 mA, IP 100 A for 1 pulse of 100 ms, TA −40 … 85 °C (range E), TJ(max) 165 °C, storage −65 … 170 °C
i_out_max_a = output source current 3 mA (the smaller of source 3 mA and sink 10 mA), p. 2

common operating characteristics, p. 5: VCC 4.5 / 5.0 / 5.5 V, ICC 10 mA typ. and 13 mA max. (VCC 5 V, output open), CLOAD ≤ 10 nF, RLOAD ≥ 4.7 kΩ, RPRIMARY 1.2 mΩ, bandwidth 80 kHz, VIOUT(Q) = VCC × 0.5, RF(INT) 1.7 kΩ

thermal, p. 5: RθJA 23 °C/W on the Allegro 85-0322 evaluation board (1500 mm² of 2 oz copper on each side at pins 1–2 and 3–4, thermal vias) – a smaller board has a higher value: rth_ja_k_per_w 23 is that board's figure, an assumption for any other board; RθJL 5 °C/W
x20A PERFORMANCE CHARACTERISTICS, p. 6: sensitivity 100 mV/A (96 … 104 mV/A), noise 11 mV peak-to-peak (CF 47 nF, 2 kHz), total output error ±1.5 % at 25 °C

isolation characteristics, p. 3 – pin v_max_v 420 on IP+/IP−: the working voltage for basic isolation between the IP leads and the signal leads (VPK or VDC), which is the voltage the primary may have against the signal ground pin 5 – not an absolute maximum of the pins: assumption that LIM.v may hold it so
VCC needs: Application 1, p. 1 (CBYP 0.1 µF); FILTER needs: CF, p. 1 and p. 4
RoHS, p. 2 note 3: -T devices are RoHS compliant using the exemptions 7(a), 15, 15(a) of Annex III/IV of 2011/65/EU (Pb-based solder bumps)
mpn, manufacturer, footprint, jlc_class, pin numbers and names: EasyEDA library data of C10681 via edakit part import, read 2026-10-31
stock: LCSC 1 325 pcs, JLCPCB assembly 1 325 pcs (2026-10-31)

compliance.rohs: RoHS compliant using exemptions 7(a), 15, 15(a) (Annex III and IV of 2011/65/EU) – -T variant
compliance.source: Allegro ACS712-DS, Rev. 22 (February 13, 2024), MCO-0000197, p. 2, selection guide note 3, read 2026-10-31

notes: Hall current sensor, no behaviour model (behavior none): the simulation draws no supply current and does not join IP+ and IP−. The sensitivity and the isolation have no field in the schema; they are in hints and sources.

checked: pinout (p. 4) = the EasyEDA symbol's pin numbers and names: 1–2 IP+, 3–4 IP−, 5 GND, 6 FILTER, 7 VIOUT, 8 VCC
selection guide: ACS712ELCTR-20A-T ±20 A, 100 mV/A, TA −40 … 85 °C (p. 2)
abs. max VCC 8 V, VIOUT 8 V, output 3 mA source / 10 mA sink, TJ 165 °C (p. 2)
operating VCC 4.5–5.5 V, ICC ≤ 13 mA, RLOAD ≥ 4.7 kΩ, CLOAD ≤ 10 nF (p. 5)
isolation 2400 VRMS / 420 VPK basic working voltage (p. 3); RθJA 23 °C/W on the evaluation board (p. 5)
sensitivity, noise and total error of the variant (x20A PERFORMANCE CHARACTERISTICS, p. 6)

2026-10-31, pin limits (schema-gaps A6, B1–B3, C1–C4): ACS712-DS Rev. 22: absolute maximum, reverse supply voltage VRCC −0.1 V and reverse output voltage VRIOUT −0.1 V (v_min_v); common operating characteristics, output resistive load RLOAD (VIOUT to GND) at least 4.7 kΩ, output capacitance load CLOAD at most 10 nF (r_load_min_ohm, c_load_max_f); output current source 3 mA and sink 10 mA differ, so no pin i_max_a
open: the schema has no field for the sensitivity (mV/A), the zero-current output (VCC/2, ratiometric), the isolation (withstand 2400 VRMS, impulse 4000 VPK, creepage/clearance 4 mm) or the primary conductor (1.2 mΩ, 100 A transient): kept in hints and sources
the primary path IP+ → IP− is not modelled (no behaviour model joins the two nets)
v_max_v 420 on the IP pins is the basic-isolation working voltage, not an absolute maximum – the owner decides whether LIM.v should hold the primary net to it
rth_ja_k_per_w 23 is the value on Allegro's 85-0322 evaluation board, not on an ordinary board
VCC bypass: 0.1 µF is the application circuit's value, read as a minimum
Allegro's product status page was not checked (ACS712 'product status' changed in Rev. 16 and 19)
